warhead.provenance: Same 1,000-lb class warhead assumed as Block IV/V per OOB (csg-us-tomahawk-navy, A); MST-specific warhead changes are not public.

fuze.provenance: No public MST-specific fuzing data; carried from the Block IV/V TLAM fuze scaffold.

_real_world.role: Anti-ship variant of Tomahawk Block V, adds multi-mode seeker for moving maritime targets
_real_world.range_nmi: n/p; ~1,000 statute miles quoted in trade press is consistent with Block IV/V range
_real_world.guidance_real: Adds multi-mode seeker (active radar + passive RF/IR claimed by Tier C, not confirmed by Tier A) to the Block IV/V INS/TERCOM/DSMAC/GPS baseline
_real_world.fielding_status: Early Operational Capability Q4 FY2025 on DDGs; submarine fielding planned early 2026; up to 1,302 conversions (Tier C-est for EOC date; Navy 2021 fact file calls MST a future capability)
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for anti-ship cruise missiles; placed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory on ship/submarine records, treated as fielded in small numbers per OOB guidance
